Thanks, Lena — received the redlines. Quick internal positions from Redwood legal/ops before we go deep:

1) Data retention / deletion: we can commit to deletion of customer logs on request within 30 days for non-production logs and 90 days for indexed audit logs. For private (VPC) deployments we offer a contract addendum that limits Redwood access; we still need to confirm HSM/KMS key ownership language with security.

2) SLA credits: we prefer an annual cap at 25% rather than 30% and will accept a 10% floor per incident. We need to preserve our ability to exclude scheduled maintenance and force majeure.

3) Term + renewal notice: 18-month firm term with 60-day renewal notice is our standard for committed capacity; we can consider 30 days if Starlight accepts a modest pricing uplift (we've modeled ~6% uplift for the shorter notice window).

Marcus — can you confirm the uplift pricing for the baseline 1.2B tokens and the two planned bursts (estimated 50% above baseline for 48 hours each)? If we agree, I'll prepare a clean MSA with tracked compromises for legal review.
